questions.question: What is the main role of ribosomes within a cell?
Where is Angkor Wat located, which has been recognised as the most photogenic UNESCO World Heritage site in Asia by Times Travel on 15 September 2024?
Which of the following is the role of wages in the Classical Theory of Unemployment in the pursuit of full employment?
options: Wages are set by the government to maintain full employment.
Wages are irrelevant in determining employment levels.
Wages are flexible and adjust to achieve full employment.
Wages are fixed and do not impact employment levels.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Wages are flexible and adjust to achieve full employment.) है।

questions.question: The bioindicator of SO2 pollutant in environment is ______.
According to the Arrhenius concept, an acid is:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (H+ liberator in water) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Indian nationalists formed the Swaraj Party within the Congress in 1923 along with Motilal Nehru and Hakim Ajmal Khan?

Which of the following Articles of the Indian constitution says that there shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State?
Which of the following ancient monuments in India is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and has numerous ruined temples dated back to the Vijayanagara period?
In which of the following years was the Food Corporation of India (FCI) established?
Which of the following launch vehicles was used in Earth Observation Satellite (EOS)-08, launched by ISRO?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV)-D3) है।

questions.question: A change of state directly from solid to gas without any change to the liquid state is called _______.
Karsandas Mulji, a social reformer in 19th century India, is most associated with advocating for which of the following?
Which of the following states has an agricultural marketing channel known as Rythu Bazars?

As per the United Nations Children’s Fund report, Ending Child Marriage: A profile of progress in India 2023, over half of the girls and women in India, who got married in their childhood, live in five states of India. Which of the following options has two of those five states?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh) है।
